enabled.name: Enable Roll Lessons
enabled.hint: Record modifier breakdowns when rolls are made. Applies to rolls made after this is turned on.

visibility.name: Who sees the breakdown
visibility.hint: Choose whether players or only the GM see the breakdown panel.

detail.name: Detail level
detail.hint: Beginner shows the rule text for each modifier. Advanced shows only the labels and values.

expanded.name: Open breakdowns by default
expanded.hint: Expand the panel automatically on new messages (this client only).

customRules.name: Custom rule text (JSON)
customRules.hint: Optional. JSON that overrides the wording of any rule, for example {"prof.expertise": {"title": "Expertise", "text": "My table wording."}}. Leave empty to use the defaults.

debug.name: Debug logging
debug.hint: Write roll configuration details to the browser console (F12). Use this when reporting a problem.

rollLog.name: Roll log
rollLog.hint: Record every roll's breakdown to Data/roll-lessons-logs/ (one file per day) so problems can be found and fixed later. Written by the GM's browser.

hideZeroDamage.name: Hide damage that can only be 0
hideZeroDamage.hint: Hides damage rolls with no dice and no bonus, such as True Strike's extra Radiant damage below level 5, from chat cards and breakdowns. The roll is kept in the data.

panel.noReason: dnd5e did not report a reason. It may have been chosen in the roll dialog or with a held key.
panel.unknownSource: Added after the roll was set up
panel.critDoubled: doubled by the critical hit to
panel.attackCrit: {name}: Critical Hit (natural 20). Hits regardless of AC.
panel.rulesNotLoaded: The rule text was not loaded in this browser when this panel was built (status: {state} {error}). Reopen the panel to retry.
panel.noRuleText: Roll Lessons has no rule text for "{key}". This is a Roll Lessons gap; it is recorded in the roll log.
panel.noKey: This part of the roll could not be matched to any source. It is recorded in the roll log.
panel.rulesFailedTitle: Rule text could not be loaded
panel.rulesFailedText: This browser could not load Roll Lessons' rule text ({error}) from {url}. Close and reopen this panel to retry. If it keeps failing, reload the page (F5).

warn.system: Roll Lessons only works with the dnd5e system.
warn.customRules: Roll Lessons: the custom rule text is not valid JSON and was ignored.
